scope: Native stepGame, unchanged production source with appended exports and verbatim AST-extracted rite UI callback. GameInput and native menu callback only after explicit replay armor admission. Hunter difficulty, zero upgrades, seeded Math.random for reproducible legal spawn jitter. Harvest mode buys its tool using two documented real mission results, and only prepares real prey killed during this run. Actions capped at 10 rising edges per second. No browser, progression, physical keyboard or visual qualification.
